Every enemy type now leaves loot that looks like what died, instead of a box. Each family shipped as its own key. Every ship passed the gate, and every ship kept the fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

- **Machines (own wreck, own shape and colours):**
  - Warden, plus the Overseer boss at a bigger scale (v29.12)
  - Pillbox (v29.13)
  - Listener (v29.16)
  - Sentry (v29.17)
  - Crawler, lying on its back (v29.19)
  - Bulwark, with its slab fallen flat (v29.20)
  - Howler (v29.21)
  - Crier (v29.24)
- **Peddler (remains, v29.25):** he lies in his duster with the hat knocked off. His pack frame, bedroll and spilled stock are beside him.
- **Already fine:** raiders and strays leave human bodies, and the deer already leaves its carcass.

Machine wrecks smoke until searched. Once searched, the hull shows an open black cavity and the smoke stops. Looting is unchanged: the loot, search time and tags are as before, and only the drawing changed.

I haven't looked at the new wrecks on screen, so how they look is untested. Each check proves the dead enemy's loot draws through its own wreck path and not the generic box. It fails on the old build and passes on the new one. The art follows the live machines' palette (outlined, same colours), and nothing in it is random.

The pack stays at 8 machine wrecks plus the peddler. I wrote a card refresh (polish pass 10) when a preflight showed the What's New card was stale, but another worker shipped that card first. The gate stopped mine harmlessly, and I did not retry it.

Notes are in `tools\handoff\console\notes\c-00a-wreckage.md`.

TASK DONE
